== Summary ==
Team tournament winners [[Brian Fred]] (standing) and [[Emil Wallin]] toast with their glass mugs at the prize ceremony.

* '''Event:''' [[2024 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2024-09-21
* '''Camera date:''' 2024-09-21 (Day 1; posted that evening)
* '''Identification:''' [[Brian Fred]]: face match with his [[:File:Brian Fred 2024 NAC Champion.jpg|2024 NAC photo]], and he won the team tournament (glass mugs) with Emil Wallin; [[Emil Wallin]]: face match with the [[:File:2024 World Championship Top 8.jpg|Top 8 photo]], and he won the team tournament with Brian Fred.
